Event rate

Source: R/blr-bivariate-analysis.R
blr_segment.Rd

Event rate by segments/levels of a qualitative variable.

Usage

blr_segment(data, response, predictor)

# Default S3 method
blr_segment(data, response, predictor)

Arguments

data

A tibble or data.frame.

response

Response variable; column in data with one or two observed, non-missing levels. The event is the second level of a factor or character response, TRUE for a logical response and 1 for a numeric response; a single level labelled "1" or TRUE is the event. Numeric responses must be coded 0/1. Unused factor levels are ignored.

predictor

Predictor variable; column in data.

Value

A tibble.

Details

A response with one observed level is allowed: the defined event rate is returned for that class (0 when all responses are non-events, 1 when all are events). A response with no observed levels is an error. Rows with a missing response are excluded. A missing predictor is kept as its own NA level, so its rows appear in a final NA segment with their own count and rate. The event rate is returned unrounded and printed to two decimal places.

See also

Other bivariate analysis procedures: blr_bivariate_analysis(), blr_segment_dist(), blr_segment_twoway(), blr_woe_iv(), blr_woe_iv_stats()

Examples

blr_segment(hsb2, honcomp, prog)
#> Event By Attributes  
#> --------------------
#> pred            1s%  
#> --------------------
#>  1             15.56 
#>  2             38.10 
#>  3             12.00 
#> --------------------
#>
